Bionic.description: A part fitted in place of the player's own: a grade of legs, the datajack or the eye.
Bionic.title: Bionic

Body.description:
Each part of the player's body that can be sold or replaced: still `present`, `sold`, or
the bionic fitted in its place. A whole body has every part present.
Body.title: Body

id.description: What it is, the same for every one of its kind, e.g. "copper_wire" or "lamp". Salvage is priced by it.
id.title: Id

name.description: What the player sees, e.g. "Copper wire".
name.title: Name

weight.description: In kg, counted against the carry limit.
weight.title: Weight

charge.description: A lamp's battery, from 0 (flat) to 1 (full). It runs down while the lamp is on, and at a plug it charges, on or off. Null for anything else.
charge.title: Charge

on.description: Whether a lamp is switched on, running its battery down. The player switches it, and it goes off by itself when it's flat. Null for anything else.
on.title: On

ItemKind.description: What it's for: `salvage` to sell, `food` to eat, the `lamp` to see by, or a `part` to fit.
ItemKind.title: ItemKind

MapTile.description: A tile on a given map: the village or an interior, or in side view a street or a floor.
MapTile.title: MapTile

Pile.description:
Items, money or both lying `at` a tile in the world for the player to pick up, such as
salvage, a secret's cash, or what they left when they collapsed.

money.description: Cash lying there, which weighs nothing. Left out while there's none.
money.title: Money

Pile.title: Pile

description:
The player's state, saved with the world. Each field defaults to the starting player's, so
a save from before the player loads with a whole body, no money and a charged lamp. Their
humanity is derived from the bionics fitted and isn't a field, so the client never sees it.

money.description: In the same units as the residents' money.
money.title: Money

items.description: What they carry. Picking things up keeps their weight within `carry_limit`.
items.title: Items

carry_limit.description: The most they carry, in kg.
carry_limit.title: Carry Limit

hunger.description: 0 is fed and 1 is starving: they collapse.
hunger.title: Hunger

left.description: What they left lying in the world, oldest first: what they carried when they collapsed, on the tile they fell on or the ground below it, and anything of a pickup that didn't fit when they took from it. Left out while there's none.
left.title: Left

taken.description: When they last took from each pickup in the world, in sim time, by pickup id. Salvage lies there again a while after it was taken, but a secret, cash or a ration, stays taken for good. Left out while there's none.
taken.title: Taken

title: Player
